text:
Sofia Alvarez: quick pass on the compact routing editor mock — focus areas: reorder affordance, validation visibility, and sim preview noise. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/compact-ux

Ben Carter: looks good overall. two quick nits: the drag handle hit area feels tiny and the reorder animation causes the preview snapshot to flicker. could we make the handle full-row height and animate transforms only? :eyes:

Ivy Park: +1 on handle. also suggest a small visual cue when a rule is 'picked up' for keyboard users (outline + aria-live). keyboard proposal: Space to pick up, Up/Down to move, Space to drop. aria-live strings: "Picked up rule 'EU mobile'", "Moved 'EU mobile' to position 2."

Marco Silva: validation copy is terse: current "invalid matcher" -> prefer "Matcher syntax error 12 expected: equals, contains, regex. Click for examples." show this inline under the rule but collapsed by default to avoid big layout shifts.

Ava Turner: regarding sim preview spam: debounce recalcs to 200ms during drag and show a tiny spinner overlay on the snapshot. preserve the sample set selection in local storage so toggling off/on doesn't reset it.

A11yBot: accessibility check: drag-and-drop must be keyboard operable and announce moves. Ensure focus returns to the moved item after drop. Color contrast note: legend amber fails in light theme, suggest #B45309.

Sofia Alvarez: decisions: 1) make handle full-height with 40px hit area, 2) implement keyboard reorder (Space/Arrows/Space) + aria-live announcements, 3) inline collapsed validation pill with docs link, 4) debounce sim recalcs to 200ms + spinner, 5) persist sample selection, 6) update legend amber to #B45309. I'll update figma and create the routing-editor tickets. Tag me on PRs. Thanks! :rocket:
